2026_01_DEN_KC.headline: Mahomes Returns to Face Broncos in High-Stakes Division Opener
2026_01_DEN_KC.paragraph1: The Denver Broncos visit the Kansas City Chiefs on Monday Night Football, marking the return of Patrick Mahomes after a season-ending knee injury. The Chiefs will be without left tackle Josh Simmons, and undrafted rookie Kahlil Benson will start in his place. The Broncos' pass rush, led by Nik Bonitto, will look to capitalize on this matchup. Meanwhile, the Chiefs' new-look backfield, featuring Kenneth Walker III, will aim to contain Denver's high-octane pass rush.
